title: AEW Star Max Caster Called Out Tom Brady, Kyrie Irving, And Herschel Walker Recently On His Way To The Ring [Watch]
htmlContent:
AEW star Max Caster name-drops Tom Brady, Kyrie Irving, and Herschel Walker during his entrance rap just before his match on Wednesday. It targets three of the most controversial athletes in the world.

Max and his teammate, Anthony Bowens, made their way to the ring to face The Gunns and Swerve in Our Glory when the 33-year-old took over the mic.

Caster didn't waste any time after TB12, who struggled all season (winning race Sunday aside) as he talks about his highly publicized divorce of ex-wife Gisèle.''

"Acclaimed on the mic got the place going crazy, ya'll about to take more L's than Tom Brady," Caster said.

"Keep the fence work (???) it's awkward, we got the receipts like he's Herschel Walker."

"I'll make you cry til' you're eyes are burning, I'mma make you say sorry like Kyrie Irving."

Of course, Tom's Bucs' team is 4-5, and after struggling on the field occasionally, some fans wondered if he should have stayed in retirement.

However, Herschel, a football legend and current U.S. Senate candidate in Georgia (his run goes to a runoff at the start of December), was attacked after being accused of having paid for the abortion of a woman even though he appeared on a pro-life platform.

Regarding Kyrie, he recently apologized to the Jewish community (although many were not satisfied with his words) after posting a link to a controversial movie containing anti-Semitic messages.
